parent.name: Original frozen Stage1 complete allocator baseline; 39 primary inputs, 16 common and unchanged downstream action/risk/recovery
parent.feature_order: exact base_features of original Stage1 seed71, no feature selection

candidate_source.issuer_2024_split_unit_rule: Official SOXX 2024-03-07 3-for-1; archived 2021/22/23 shares multiplied by 3 equal current retrospective workbook on all 15661 overlapping calendar rows. Use only current internally split-adjusted share ratios; do not mix raw level units.
candidate_source.first_public_timing: unverified conditional as-if availability. Three workbooks/three pages and two-session lag are not proof of every historical daily receipt.

single_feature.name: issuer_creation_5d_after_negative_soxx_trend
single_feature.formula: At Stage1 signal Qlib session t: 1{original Stage1 soxx_ret20(t)<0} * log(SOXX issuer shares_outstanding(t-2)/shares_outstanding(t-7)), where t-k means kth prior native Qlib trading session. The issuer share series comes from its official current retrospective workbook, never weekend-filled.
single_feature.hypothesis: Positive issuer net creation after a negative SOXX trend indicates absorbed selling or renewed primary-market demand and increases the next five-open SOXX return relative to original Stage1 information.
single_feature.novelty: Issuer primary-market shares differ from already closed signed secondary-market volume participation; original Stage1 39 features contain no issuer share count.

label.primary: Five funded open-to-open SOXX intervals from original Stage1 signal s: sum j=0..4 log1p(soxx_forward_open_return(s+j)) on five consecutive native signal-calendar rows.
label.maturity: Original Stage1 timing.return_available_at of fifth interval row, train strictly before 2023-01-01 America/New_York and held before 2026-10-10 America/New_York.
label.role: Only matched incremental information, not fee-net strategy return.

model.baseline: Original 39 Stage1 input columns; SimpleImputer(median) then StandardScaler then Ridge(alpha=1.0)
model.candidate: Exact same receiver, cohorts, label and settings plus the one issuer_creation_5d_after_negative_soxx_trend coordinate

information_gate.paired_metric: On identical held signals, baseline squared error minus candidate squared error for five-open SOXX log return.

barrier: Independent scoped design approval bound to exact plan/notebook source, no-fit Qlib preflight, and unchanged source hashes before first fit. If any information gate fails, close fixed feature version. Even if all pass, evidence remains conditional retrospective, cannot authorize own-state 0bp account, 2/5bp, promotion or forward qualification until historical source timing is separately qualified.
